class-inheritance.title: Class inheritance
class-inheritance.short: Extend a base class with extends
class-inheritance.summary: Extend a base class with extends
class-inheritance.why: Inheritance lets a subclass reuse base behavior and specialize only what differs.
class-inheritance.tips: Prefer composition when the relationship is not a clear is-a relationship.

interface-default-method.title: Interface default methods
interface-default-method.short: Give an interface a default implementation
interface-default-method.summary: Give an interface a default implementation
interface-default-method.why: Default methods let interfaces evolve with behavior without immediately breaking existing implementations.
interface-default-method.tips: If inherited defaults conflict, override the method explicitly in the implementing class.

enum-type.title: Enums
enum-type.short: Represent a fixed set of constants as a type
enum-type.summary: Represent a fixed set of constants as a type
enum-type.why: Enums model a finite set of states with type safety and work naturally with switch.
enum-type.tips: Do not persist ordinal values; use explicit fields when an external representation is needed.

annotations-basics.title: Annotations
annotations-basics.why: Annotations provide metadata to the compiler and frameworks for validation, generation, and runtime processing.
annotations-basics.tips: Use compiler-checked annotations such as @Override to catch mistakes early.

method-references.title: Method references
method-references.short: Use Class::method as a compact lambda
method-references.summary: Use Class::method as a compact lambda
method-references.why: Method references concisely pass an existing method where a functional interface is expected.
method-references.tips: Use a lambda instead when the parameter mapping is clearer that way.

lambda-expressions.title: Lambda expressions
lambda-expressions.why: Lambdas pass behavior without an anonymous class and are central to streams and callbacks.
lambda-expressions.tips: Captured local variables must be effectively final; avoid capturing shared mutable state.

try-with-resources.title: try-with-resources
try-with-resources.why: try-with-resources closes resources reliably on both success and failure, preventing leaks.
try-with-resources.tips: Prefer it for APIs returning AutoCloseable values such as streams, readers, and input streams.

module-system.title: Java module system
module-system.short: Declare dependencies and exports in module-info.java
module-system.summary: Declare dependencies and exports in module-info.java
module-system.why: JPMS makes dependencies and exported packages explicit, strengthening boundaries in larger applications.
module-system.tips: When migrating gradually, check class-path/module-path mixing and automatic module names.

record-patterns.title: Record patterns
record-patterns.why: Record patterns combine type testing and component extraction into a concise data-deconstruction form.
record-patterns.tips: Nested patterns are powerful, but helper methods may be clearer than deeply nested patterns.

sequenced-collections.title: Sequenced Collections
sequenced-collections.why: Sequenced collection interfaces provide common operations such as getFirst, getLast, and reversed.
sequenced-collections.tips: Check which existing collection implementations implement these interfaces and require Java 21+.

list-of-immutable.title: Immutable lists with List.of
list-of-immutable.why: List.of is a concise way to create an unmodifiable list for fixed data.
list-of-immutable.tips: It rejects null and mutation; copy into an ArrayList when modification is required.

map-of-immutable.title: Immutable maps with Map.of
map-of-immutable.why: Map.of creates small fixed maps with concise initialization.
map-of-immutable.tips: Duplicate keys and null keys/values are rejected; use Map.ofEntries for larger maps.

set-of-immutable.title: Immutable sets with Set.of
set-of-immutable.why: Set.of represents a fixed set concisely and rejects duplicate elements at construction.
set-of-immutable.tips: It rejects null and mutation; use a mutable Set implementation when elements must change.

collectors-groupingby.title: Group with Collectors.groupingBy
collectors-groupingby.short: Group stream elements by a classifier
collectors-groupingby.summary: Group stream elements by a classifier
collectors-groupingby.why: groupingBy collects elements into groups keyed by a classifier function.
collectors-groupingby.tips: Combine downstream collectors to count, sum, or transform each group in one collection step.

collectors-joining.title: Join strings with Collectors.joining
collectors-joining.why: joining expresses string concatenation as a collector and can add delimiters, prefixes, and suffixes.
collectors-joining.tips: For a simple list of strings, String.join may be clearer.

files-lines.title: Read lines with Files.lines
files-lines.short: Process a text file as Stream<String>
files-lines.summary: Process a text file as Stream<String>
files-lines.why: Files.lines streams file lines without first loading the whole file into one String.
files-lines.tips: The returned stream owns a resource, so close it with try-with-resources.

files-write-string.title: Write text with Files.writeString
files-write-string.short: Write a String directly to a file
files-write-string.summary: Write a String directly to a file
files-write-string.why: Files.writeString is a concise choice for small to medium text files and supports explicit charsets.
files-write-string.tips: For very large or incremental output, a Writer may use memory more efficiently.

string-is-blank.title: String.isBlank
string-is-blank.short: Check for empty or whitespace-only text
string-is-blank.summary: Check for empty or whitespace-only text
string-is-blank.why: isBlank checks both empty strings and strings containing only Unicode whitespace.
string-is-blank.tips: It does not handle null, so nullable input still needs separate handling.

string-lines.title: String.lines
string-lines.why: String.lines exposes text lines as a stream without manual newline splitting.
string-lines.tips: The stream is single-use; collect it if the parsed lines must be reused.

completablefuture-timeout.title: CompletableFuture timeouts
completablefuture-timeout.why: orTimeout completes a CompletableFuture exceptionally if it does not finish within the deadline.
completablefuture-timeout.tips: Timing out the future does not necessarily stop the underlying work; design cancellation separately.

illegal-argument-exception.title: IllegalArgumentException
illegal-argument-exception.why: This common unchecked exception indicates that a caller supplied a value outside the method contract.
illegal-argument-exception.tips: Include the parameter name and expected range in the message when useful.

illegal-state-exception.title: IllegalStateException
illegal-state-exception.short: Signal that an operation is invalid in the current state
illegal-state-exception.summary: Signal that an operation is invalid in the current state
illegal-state-exception.why: Use IllegalStateException when the object state, rather than an argument, makes an operation invalid.
illegal-state-exception.tips: Make valid state transitions clear so exceptions do not become normal control flow.

no-such-element-exception.title: NoSuchElementException
no-such-element-exception.short: Handle requests for an element that is not present
no-such-element-exception.summary: Handle requests for an element that is not present
no-such-element-exception.why: This exception appears when code asks for an element that does not exist, such as Optional.get on empty.
no-such-element-exception.tips: For Optional, prefer operations such as map, orElse, or orElseThrow over unchecked get calls.

arithmetic-exception.title: ArithmeticException
arithmetic-exception.short: Handle invalid arithmetic operations such as integer division by zero
arithmetic-exception.summary: Handle invalid arithmetic operations such as integer division by zero
arithmetic-exception.why: ArithmeticException is thrown for arithmetic operations that cannot be performed, notably integer division by zero.
arithmetic-exception.tips: Validate divisors and remember that floating-point division has different Infinity/NaN behavior.

unsupported-operation-exception.title: UnsupportedOperationException
unsupported-operation-exception.short: Handle operations a type does not support
unsupported-operation-exception.summary: Handle operations a type does not support
unsupported-operation-exception.why: Unmodifiable collections such as List.of throw this exception for add or remove.
unsupported-operation-exception.tips: Check mutability contracts and copy into a mutable implementation when modification is needed.

completion-exception.title: CompletionException
completion-exception.why: CompletableFuture.join wraps an asynchronous failure in CompletionException.
completion-exception.tips: Inspect getCause and avoid swallowing the original failure context.

timeout-exception.title: TimeoutException
timeout-exception.short: Handle operations that miss a deadline
timeout-exception.summary: Handle operations that miss a deadline
timeout-exception.why: Timed Future.get and similar APIs throw TimeoutException when work does not finish before the deadline.
timeout-exception.tips: Define retry, cancellation, and user-visible timeout behavior explicitly.

file-already-exists-exception.title: FileAlreadyExistsException
file-already-exists-exception.short: Handle attempts to create a path that already exists
file-already-exists-exception.summary: Handle attempts to create a path that already exists
file-already-exists-exception.why: Creation APIs such as Files.createFile throw this when the target already exists.
file-already-exists-exception.tips: Decide whether existing files should be replaced or rejected and choose the appropriate Files API.

missing-return-statement.title: missing return statement
missing-return-statement.short: Return a value on every reachable path
missing-return-statement.summary: Return a value on every reachable path
missing-return-statement.why: A non-void method must return a value on every reachable execution path.
missing-return-statement.tips: With many branches, use clear early returns or a final common return and verify no path falls through.

method-does-not-override.title: @Override mismatch
method-does-not-override.short: Check that the method really overrides a parent declaration
method-does-not-override.summary: Check that the method really overrides a parent declaration
method-does-not-override.why: @Override causes a compile error when the method signature does not match an inherited declaration.
method-does-not-override.tips: Check spelling, parameter types, return type, and visibility instead of simply removing @Override.

ambiguous-method-call.title: Ambiguous method call
ambiguous-method-call.why: When multiple overloads are equally applicable, the compiler cannot choose one.
ambiguous-method-call.tips: Use an explicit argument type or simplify the overload set, especially around null arguments.

generic-bound-mismatch.title: Generic bound mismatch
generic-bound-mismatch.short: Pass a type that satisfies the generic bound
generic-bound-mismatch.summary: Pass a type that satisfies the generic bound
generic-bound-mismatch.why: A type argument must satisfy bounds such as T extends Number.
generic-bound-mismatch.tips: Check required bounds at call sites and avoid unnecessarily restrictive bounds in API design.

duplicate-local-variable.title: Duplicate local variable
duplicate-local-variable.short: Do not redeclare the same local name in one scope
duplicate-local-variable.summary: Do not redeclare the same local name in one scope
duplicate-local-variable.why: Java does not allow two local variable declarations with the same name in the same scope.
duplicate-local-variable.tips: Assign to the existing variable or choose a different name when it represents a different value.

unreachable-statement.title: Unreachable statement
unreachable-statement.short: Remove code the compiler proves can never execute
unreachable-statement.summary: Remove code the compiler proves can never execute
unreachable-statement.why: Java rejects statements that are provably unreachable, such as code directly after an unconditional return.
unreachable-statement.tips: Simplify control flow and check for stale debug code or misplaced return/throw statements.

variable-might-not-have-been-initialized.title: Variable might not have been initialized
variable-might-not-have-been-initialized.short: Assign a local on every path before use
variable-might-not-have-been-initialized.summary: Assign a local on every path before use
variable-might-not-have-been-initialized.why: Java's definite-assignment analysis requires local variables to be provably assigned before they are read.
variable-might-not-have-been-initialized.tips: Give an initial value, assign in every branch, or restructure the code as an expression returning the value.

private-access-error.title: Private access error
private-access-error.why: A private member cannot be accessed directly from outside its declaring class.
private-access-error.tips: Expose intentional behavior through methods instead of widening fields to public without considering encapsulation.

final-variable-assignment.title: Assignment to a final variable
final-variable-assignment.short: Assign a final variable only once
final-variable-assignment.summary: Assign a final variable only once
final-variable-assignment.why: A final local variable or field cannot be assigned a different value after initialization.
final-variable-assignment.tips: Remember that final fixes the reference, not necessarily the mutability of the referenced object.

switch-not-exhaustive.title: Non-exhaustive switch
switch-not-exhaustive.short: Cover every possible value in a switch expression
switch-not-exhaustive.summary: Cover every possible value in a switch expression
switch-not-exhaustive.why: Value-producing and pattern switches must cover every possible input accepted by the selector type.
switch-not-exhaustive.tips: For enums and sealed hierarchies, list all cases and decide deliberately whether a default is appropriate.

serial-warning.title: serial warning
serial-warning.why: -Xlint:serial can warn when a Serializable class lacks explicit serialization version metadata.
serial-warning.tips: First consider whether Java serialization is needed; if it is, manage compatibility deliberately.

varargs-heap-pollution-warning.title: Varargs heap-pollution warning
varargs-heap-pollution-warning.why: Generic varargs are backed by arrays and can break type safety for non-reifiable element types.
varargs-heap-pollution-warning.tips: Use @SafeVarargs only when the implementation is genuinely safe and does not corrupt the array.

removal-warning.title: Removal warning
removal-warning.short: Migrate away from APIs deprecated for removal
removal-warning.summary: Migrate away from APIs deprecated for removal
removal-warning.why: APIs deprecated with forRemoval=true signal a stronger expectation that they will disappear.
removal-warning.tips: Find the replacement early to avoid surprises during future JDK upgrades.

preview-feature-warning.title: Preview feature warning
preview-feature-warning.why: Preview features may change or disappear and require explicit opt-in during compilation and execution.
preview-feature-warning.tips: Pin the JDK and preview dependency carefully in production-like code and track changes before finalization.

fallthrough-warning.title: switch fall-through warning
fallthrough-warning.why: Traditional switch statements continue into the next case when break is omitted, which -Xlint:fallthrough can flag.
fallthrough-warning.tips: Document intentional fall-through and consider arrow-style switch rules for simple branching.

autounboxing-null.title: Null during auto-unboxing
autounboxing-null.short: Do not auto-unbox a null wrapper
autounboxing-null.summary: Do not auto-unbox a null wrapper
autounboxing-null.why: Auto-unboxing a null Integer, Boolean, or other wrapper throws NullPointerException.
autounboxing-null.tips: Check why a wrapper is needed and handle null explicitly when absence is valid.

bigdecimal-equals-scale.title: BigDecimal equality and scale
bigdecimal-equals-scale.short: Use compareTo when numeric equality is intended
bigdecimal-equals-scale.summary: Use compareTo when numeric equality is intended
bigdecimal-equals-scale.why: BigDecimal.equals compares both numeric value and scale, so 1.0 and 1.00 are not equal by equals.
bigdecimal-equals-scale.tips: Use compareTo for numeric equality and remember equals semantics when BigDecimal is used as a key.

hashmap-null-ambiguity.title: Map.get null ambiguity
hashmap-null-ambiguity.short: Distinguish a missing key from a stored null value
hashmap-null-ambiguity.summary: Distinguish a missing key from a stored null value
hashmap-null-ambiguity.why: A null result from Map.get alone cannot tell whether the key is absent or explicitly mapped to null.
hashmap-null-ambiguity.tips: Use containsKey when the distinction matters, or design the map to reject null values.

parallel-stream-side-effects.title: Parallel-stream side effects
parallel-stream-side-effects.short: Avoid shared mutable state in parallel pipelines
parallel-stream-side-effects.summary: Avoid shared mutable state in parallel pipelines
parallel-stream-side-effects.why: Mutating the same external collection from parallel stream workers can cause races and corruption.
parallel-stream-side-effects.tips: Use stream collectors and pure transformations instead of side effects on shared state.

or-else-eager.title: Optional.orElse eager evaluation
or-else-eager.short: Use orElseGet for expensive fallback computation
or-else-eager.summary: Use orElseGet for expensive fallback computation
or-else-eager.why: The argument to orElse is evaluated even when the Optional already contains a value.
or-else-eager.tips: Use orElseGet with a Supplier when creating the fallback is expensive or has side effects.

mutable-list-from-arrays-aslist.title: Fixed-size lists from Arrays.asList
mutable-list-from-arrays-aslist.short: Copy into ArrayList when add/remove is required
mutable-list-from-arrays-aslist.summary: Copy into ArrayList when add/remove is required
mutable-list-from-arrays-aslist.why: Arrays.asList returns a list backed by the array; set works, but size-changing add/remove operations do not.
mutable-list-from-arrays-aslist.tips: Create a new ArrayList from it when the list must grow or shrink.

locale-sensitive-case.title: Locale-sensitive case conversion
locale-sensitive-case.why: String case conversion uses the default locale and can produce different results in different environments.
locale-sensitive-case.tips: Use the user's locale for natural-language text and Locale.ROOT for protocol tokens and identifiers.
